frozen_before: any retained rights request, HEAD request or dataset acquisition

required_evidence: official dataset-card metadata declares the dataset repository's license
official history contains v1.5/lift/ph/low_dim_v141.hdf5 before its zero-content-change rename
the acquired Stanford file's SHA-256 equals the official repository artifact's LFS SHA-256
rights_gate.decision: Only exact byte equality binds the Stanford object to the official repository terms. A matching name, public link or robomimic software license is insufficient.
rights_gate.failure: If the license, artifact digest or byte identity cannot be retained, stop unresolved before training.

retained_network_plan.note: Six pre-freeze interactive web-tool calls located the official sources. Their request count, response bytes and CPU cost are unavailable; they fetched no dataset body and are disclosed rather than counted as retained acquisition evidence.

pre_acquisition_checks: system memory pressure and physical-memory readback
all five protected historical failed files remain exact
stopping_rules: stop before GET if Content-Length is absent, exceeds 32 MiB, or would exceed the 64 MiB cumulative known-source limit
stop after GET if the exact size or digest differs from retained official metadata
do not substitute another dataset generation or widen acquisition after a failure
do not begin training until dataset membership, environment metadata and the complete pilot contract are frozen
